vision.name: Visiting the Past
vision.text:
(Limit 2 per deck.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your discard pile for a card and place it into your hand. If you have more than 3 cards in your hand, place a card from your hand at the bottom of your Life Deck.
